attackers_goals: Use an account that was possibly compromised to gain access to the network.
description: RDP is used by attackers to laterally move to new hosts. Standard processes do not usually implement RDP on their own, and attackers might inject or tunnel using a non-standard process.
investigative_actions: Validate if the process is a legitimate IT software. Verify if the process is known to be malicious. Look into actions done on the remote host.
name: Uncommon RDP connection
